resources.string: Translate received messages and captions on this device. Originals and outgoing messages stay unchanged. Language models download as needed (about 30 MB per language, up to four languages); translation then works offline. Tap the chat banner to show originals or change language. Showing originals stops translation; an already started model download may finish in the background.
Language could not be identified or is unsupported; original shown.
Translation unavailable. Check your connection, Wi-Fi and free space, then tap Retry. Original messages are preserved.
Up to four downloaded languages are kept on this device. Delete translation models before downloading another language.
Allow model downloads using mobile data? Each language uses about 30 MB. Mobile data charges may apply. A download already waiting for Wi-Fi may still need Wi-Fi.
Translation will be turned off for this chat. Downloaded translation models are shared between chats and will need to be downloaded again.
